testCase.name: [本地] S15 Local-development leftovers do not reach a shipped build

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S15 「本地开发的遗留不进发出去的 build」 Local-development leftovers do not reach a shipped build

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Every network request the app makes (web, iOS and Android, in Hospital and Nursing Home) uses HTTPS. There is no plain-HTTP endpoint anywhere.（UAT OAT-02；UAT 4；TFA-92568 AC 4；TFA-92568 Eng 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given The UAT build's source and its release artefacts

When Look for each known leftover: .env.mobile.local (VITE_MOBILE_LOCAL=true, http://127.0.0.1:3210/3211 or a LAN IP); the SITE_URL fallback 'http://localhost:5173' in convex/auth.ts; the trusted origins http://localhost, *.e2b.app and WebContainer; …

Then None of them makes a hosted or store build talk to an http:// host. SITE_URL on the deployment is the https web origin. The store builds were made with VITE_MOBILE_LOCAL=false and https URLs.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-02 step 1. A shipped build that sends any request to an http:// host = Fail. Any http:// entry in BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS other than localhost = Fail. Allowances that carry no traffic, localhost origins included, are judged per Q6.

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S15 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-02.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。

测试方法：STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描）；辅助：CONFIG · 配置核对 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：code-review。

UAT item: OAT-02 Encryption Verification · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-02/S15

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress)

本地新 lane code-review：code-review/results.json 里 status partial → 待人看（部分：能查的这半通过，另一半要别的 lane / 人 / 文件 → 待人看）。

Detail:

Built bundles (placeholder https env): local strings web {"localhost":3}, mobile {"localhost":3}; http:// URL literals: none. Source leftovers: Android debug network config allows cleartext to localhost, 127.0.0.1, 172.20.10.6 (debug builds only); iOS NSAllowsLocalNetworking present; .env.mobile.local is git-ignored (not in the commit). The convex/auth.ts SITE_URL fallback and trusted origins are backend code, see OAT-02/S06 and OAT-02/S08's code review; the SITE_URL and BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS values on the deployment need Tim (CONFIG).

还要（needs）：CONFIG (Tim): scheme of SITE_URL and each BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS entry; store build env (VITE_MOBILE_LOCAL=false, https URLs)

证据：附了 4 个。

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: scripted-spec, outside-runner (manual: doc-review). This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
